CI EVIDENCE for Gerrit change 1233 (patch set 1, run 30771122330). LLM-Review +1 (rebar review bot,
PASS). Every job in the Verified lane is GREEN except one:

  success  clear Verified (reset to 0)
  success  artifact-probe / artifact provenance (wheel/sdist probe)
  success  eval-discipline / eval discipline (offline — no model)
  success  optionality / clean core wheel (no extras -> heavy deps absent)
  success  optionality / optional extras isolate (per-extra venvs + union)
  success  require resolvable rebar ticket
  success  verify-identity (whole-store authorship gate)
  success  golden-path (clean install)
  success  build-and-test / lint + type-check
  FAILURE  build-and-test / pip-audit (dependency vulnerabilities)   <-- NOT this change
  success  build-and-test / pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.11)
  success  build-and-test / pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.12)
  success  build-and-test / pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.13)
  success  build-and-test / pytest (macos-latest, py3.13)

The pip-audit failure is the pre-existing click 8.2.1 / PYSEC-2026-2132 finding reproducing on every
change pushed today at base 4214516f95; it is owned by ticket e47e-a33d-b9cf-4421 and is not
recheckable (the audit reaches the advisory DB and finds a real finding; the workflow only retries
DB-unreachable failures). This change touches only four test files — no uv.lock, no workflow, no
src/** — so it cannot be the cause. Its only failing step is
"pip-audit (scan installed environment; gating, network-retried)"; every other step in that job,
including the install from the committed lock, succeeded.

The py3.11 pytest job passing matters specifically here: CI runs 3.11 while this host is 3.13/3.14,
and Python 3.12 changed runtime-checkable Protocol isinstance() from hasattr to
inspect.getattr_static. The rewrites introduce no isinstance()-against-Protocol check — presence is
asserted with hasattr directly — and py3.11, py3.12, py3.13 and macos py3.13 all agree. The
macos-latest py3.13 job also ran the module-size gate green (largest touched file 533 LOC against
the 800 cap).

Not closing: waiting for the pip-audit blocker to clear so Verified can go +1 and the change can
land.
